title: China Big Fund III
summary: The third state semiconductor fund, capitalised at RMB 344bn and aimed at equipment and materials.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

The National Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund's third phase was registered in May 2024 with RMB 344bn, larger than the first two phases combined. Its stated focus is on equipment, materials and advanced packaging — the bottlenecks that export controls made visible — rather than on fab construction alone. State capital of this size changes the cost of failure for domestic toolmakers.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Mass production
Estimated window 2024–2030
Confidence label Confirmed
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

Subsidised capacity can run at a loss for years, which means import substitution may happen faster than cost curves alone would predict.

What Would Change The View

  • Disbursement pace versus announcements.
  • Which equipment segments receive allocations.
  • Whether funded capacity finds customers.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
